status: GPU execution authorized by user; at most eight H200s concurrently
objective: Improve deployable sequence-to-structure accuracy at measured end-to-end cost
development_set: existing exp-val; explicitly reused development data
final_test: new experimental holdout, selected and locked before new training

first_gpu_stage.target_selection: fixed manifest, stratified by length and chain continuity
first_gpu_stage.selection: first sample only for primary comparisons; oracle clearly separated
first_gpu_stage.timing: same GPU and targets; include ESMC, flow, decoder, selection; warm-up separately
first_gpu_stage.gate: 100% accounted targets, fixed-correspondence controls pass, legacy parity passes; then extend finalists to all development targets

ordered_training_hypotheses.hypothesis: A subset of available ESMC layers exposes geometry better than the last layer
ordered_training_hypotheses.comparison: last layer versus scalar mix of a few cached layers; same head, data, optimizer steps, seeds
ordered_training_hypotheses.gate: pilot probe and fold improvement on untouched development subset justify full cache

ordered_training_hypotheses.hypothesis: Latent target ambiguity and decoder sensitivity dominate prediction error
ordered_training_hypotheses.comparison: stratify errors by decoder sensitivity, PCA eigengaps and sign stability; latent-only versus calibrated geometry-aware endpoint loss
ordered_training_hypotheses.gate: positive gradient and geometry controls, no validity regression

ordered_training_hypotheses.hypothesis: A faster point predictor can distil a good conditional sample
ordered_training_hypotheses.comparison: teacher-derived selected targets on training sequences only; one-step and 4-step students versus retained flow teacher
ordered_training_hypotheses.gate: non-oracle accuracy-cost improvement including ESMC and decoder; no collapse on difficult targets

predeclared_promotion_rule.accuracy_track: paired mean TM gain at least 0.01, cluster bootstrap lower bound above zero, three seeds, no material CA-lDDT or geometry regression
predeclared_promotion_rule.speed_track: at least 2x measured end-to-end speed, paired TM noninferiority lower bound above -0.005, predeclared CI procedure
predeclared_promotion_rule.note: These are proposed practical thresholds, not achieved results. Cluster labels and a held-out final test still need construction.
